description:
Dolt is a SQL database that you can fork, clone, branch, merge, push and pull just like a git repository.

Dolt is a SQL database that you can fork, clone, branch, merge, push and pull just like a git repository.
Connect to Dolt just like any MySQL database to run queries or update the data using SQL commands.
Use the command line interface to import CSV files, commit your changes, push them to a remote, or merge your teammate's changes.
Merged PRs
dolt
- 12587: Fix index lookups on temporary tables
  - Fixes #12580: a contradictory WHERE on an indexed temporary table panicked and dropped the connection. Temporary tables now hand out one partition per index range, so an empty range set yields an empty result.
  - Disjunctions on an indexed temporary table column (x = 1 OR x = 2) no longer fail with "expected a single index range".
  - Index lookups on temporary tables large enough to have several scan partitions no longer return duplicate rows.
  - Move engine tests into their own file (last commit).
- 12575: Pass a context to the schema formatter when generating column definitions
  Passes a context to the schema formatter when generating column definitions, so that it can show expressions under the session's search path.
  Companion PRs: dolthub/go-mysql-server#4186, dolthub/doltgresql#3909
- 12574: Bulk dependabot bumps
  - Bump github.com/klauspost/compress 1.17.8 -> 1.18.7 in go-mysql client tests (#12158)
  - Bump github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 4.1.4 -> 4.1.6 (#12228)
  - Bump MySqlConnector 2.4.0 -> 2.6.1 in dotnet client tests (#12281)
  - Bump org.mariadb.jdbc:mariadb-java-client 3.5.9 -> 3.5.11 in java client tests (#12299)
  - Bump go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace 1.44.0 -> 1.47.0 (#12491)
- 12567: go.mod: Bump eventsapi_schema. Pick up idempotency_level annotation.
- 12563: Read archive index with a single ranged read
  Partial fix for #12558: opening an archive on a blobstore remote issued four ranged GETs for its index, one per contiguous section. It now reads the whole index once. Cloning an S3 remote with 157 small archives drops from 1,415 to 944 GETs.
- 12559: binlogreplication: create Dolt commits before advancing gtid_executed
  Fixes the intermittent TestDoltCommits failure (expected 5 commits, got 4). The binlog replica advanced @@gtid_executed and saved its position before running dolt_commit for the transaction, so anything waiting on gtid_executed could see the replica as caught up before the last Dolt commit existed. The replica now creates the Dolt commits first, then records the GTID.
- 12555: Make dolt_tag changes visible to dolt_tags in the same transaction
  Fixes dolt_tags not showing tags created or deleted by dolt_tag earlier in the same transaction.
  Fixes #12553
- 12554: bats: fix remotesrv tests still using port 50051
  Fixes lambdabats failures on main in remotesrv: read only server rejects writes and the two shallow-clone: fsck passes tests. They still used port 50051 after remotesrv ports were made per-test in #12053.
- 12552: remotesrv: return forward-slash download URL paths on Windows
  Fixes #12519: on Windows, remotesrv download URLs contained backslashes from filepath.Rel, which the file handler rejects with 400 since the repo path validation was added. Store and oldgen prefixes are now converted to slash form. Based on #12550 by @jay23606.
- 12543: /go/{cmd,libraries}: ensure cleanup runs whenever git remote is used
  Fixes #12328, ensures the cleanup actually runs whenever a Gitr remote is used, previously did not run during dolt sql-server invocations.
- 12542: Fix stale docs links in the README
  - Fix the dead Dolt commits docs link in the getting-started walkthrough (from #12539 by @farisbasha, commit kept as authored).
  - Point the Gas Town link at its current repo, github.com/gastownhall/gastown.
- 12541: Refuse over-long branch and tag names instead of panicking or wrapping
  Branch and tag names over ~32K bytes panicked with "impossible node", and names over 64K silently wrapped the 16-bit node offsets. Branch and tag names are now limited to 1024 bytes and refused cleanly before anything is written, AddressMap rejects keys over 16 KiB with an error, and invalid-name panics in branch/tag creation are now errors.
  Fixes: dolthub/doltgresql#3895
- 12534: Add a row merge policy hook for transaction commits
  Adds a hook that decides each row two concurrent transaction commits both changed.
  Companion PR: dolthub/doltgresql#3887
- 12526: Reset table writers after materializing pending edits, not during
  Rebuilding a table writer with a partial index could read the working set while pending edits were still being saved, which panicked. Writers are now rebuilt after the save finishes.
  Fixes: dolthub/doltgresql#3877
- 12481: Arm GC cancellation wakeups only when waiting, using context.AfterFunc in ValueStore
  Arm GC cancellation wakeups only when waiting, using context.AfterFunc in ValueStore.
- 12472: Remove use of channels from prollyKeylessIndexIter
  When iterating over indexes for keyless tables, we used to goroutines, where one reads from storage and sends the results over a channel. This was presumably a performance optimization to avoid blocking plan execution on IO, but:
  - None of the other index types do this
  - It complicates iteration logic
  - Removing this shows no significant performance impact, and possible performance gains.

  Bumps mariadb from 3.5.3 to 3.5.4. Release notes
  Sourced from mariadb's releases.
  > MariaDB Connector/Node.js 3.5.4
  >
  > 3.5.4 (Jul 2026)
  >
  > Full Changelog
  >
  > Notable changes
  > - CONJS-355: Avoid flat-cloning the connection options for every command, relying on a prototype-chain merge instead (#353 thanks to erulabs)
  > - CONJS-357: Add JavaScript SAST (CodeQL + eslint-plugin-security) to CI
  > - CONJS-365: Enable standard TLS certificate identity validation under Deno
  > - CONJS-366: New option maxAllowedColumns (default 65535) bounding the column count announced by the server, a rogue server being otherwise able to have the client allocate metadata for a result-set that will never complete (report by fg0x0)
  >
  > Issues Fixed
  > - CONJS-329: An exception thrown by a callback was reported to that same callback as a database error, instead of propagating like it does from any other node-style callback (report by Assen Totin)
  > - CONJS-356: Corrected ed25519 authentication with zero-configuration SSL
  > - CONJS-358: Refuse multi-part packet (> 16MB) reassembly before authentication completes, a rogue server being otherwise able to exhaust client memory before any credential is even validated
  > - CONJS-359: Corrected the default maxAllowedPacket value when the option is not set
  > - CONJS-360: batch() ignored the insertIdAsNumber / supportBigNumbers / bigNumberStrings options for insertId
  > - CONJS-361: The connection stopped sending commands after a command ending on the last packet of a network chunk: a prepared statement was never executed, without error nor timeout (report by Assen Totin)
  > - CONJS-362: Limit the parsec authentication PBKDF2 iteration factor and move the key derivation off the event loop, a rogue server being otherwise able to freeze the whole process for minutes (report by fg0x0)
  > - CONJS-363: typeCast accessors returned corrupted values with prepared statements
  > - CONJS-364: Types / TypeNumbers enums threw at runtime (#347, contribution by BrianDouglasIE)
